notes.content: EMPHASIS REQUIREMENTS The total coursework requirements for the Biology - Secondary Teaching Emphasis, B.A. include a minimum of 48 units of Biology, Chemistry, Physical Science and Mathematics beyond the General Education prerequisites, of which a minimum of 24 must be upper division. In addition to GEOL 151 and PHYS 120 & 120L, students must complete additional courses in biology or physical sciences to complete 48 units in the major. TEACHER EDUCATION PROGRAM INFORMATION Students who are interested in applying for admission to the Teacher Education Program should refer to the Graduate School description of admissions requirements for the program and obtain academic advising from the program at least two semesters prior to completion of their degrees. **Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU** This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php .

EMPHASIS REQUIREMENTS

The total coursework requirements for the Biology - Secondary Teaching Emphasis, B.A. include a minimum of 48 units of Biology, Chemistry, Physical Science and Mathematics beyond the General Education prerequisites, of which a minimum of 24 must be upper division. In addition to GEOL 151 and PHYS 120 & 120L, students must complete additional courses in biology or physical sciences to complete 48 units in the major.


TEACHER EDUCATION PROGRAM INFORMATION

Students who are interested in applying for admission to the Teacher Education Program should refer to the Graduate School description of admissions requirements for the program and obtain academic advising from the program at least two semesters prior to completion of their degrees.


﻿**Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU**

This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php.
